description: Who has actually been hired and paid on BNB Smart Chain. Reads the ERC-8183 job escrow kernel: jobs created, jobs funded, deliverables submitted, and escrow actually released — per provider. A registration is self-reported; a funded job is somebody else's money. Pass an address to get one provider's balance, or nothing for the whole kernel. A dated snapshot of the last full read, not a live call: measured_at says when.
